lead: Based on what you told me, your number one constraint is:
h1: You’re [[educating buyers on the call]], instead of closing them.
fix_h: Reserve your calls for buyers to **confirm their commitment**, not to build it from scratch.
arr_k: What they’re thinking as they join
now_say: “I’ll jump on and see what they’re about.”
now_note: 45 minutes of convincing, then weeks of follow-ups.
fix_say: “They know their stuff. I’ll ask my one question and then buy.”
fix_note: The call is for the last few questions.
how_h: To bring your close rate up and shrink your sales cycle:
fan_tap: Tap the card for the next one
how1: **Pre-educate before the call.** Show your process, your difference and your price range up front, so the call is for the last few questions, not “convince me you’re not a knob”.
how2: **Personalize the pre-sales experience.** You attract two different personas, each with different use cases, objections and reasons to buy, so show each one the right features, testimonials and answers before they ever speak to you.
how3: **Filter misfits early, without lowering your threshold.** Stop hoping a call will convert someone who was never the right fit, and let the tire-kickers filter themselves out.
lens: Through the **Revenue Per Visitor™** lens, this raises your sales call close rate. It sits in Speed to Decision™, quadrant 3 of the Compounding Revenue Per Visitor™ OS.
cta: Show me how to close more of my calls
up_next: Next question: What have you already tried to improve your revenue?
